new_findings.expected_impact: identifies the single fixable 1/3 of the decode step; removing it entirely would be +50%, the two available replacements measured +15-22% end-to-end
new_findings.what: Decode-step GPU time budget at conc=64 measured with torch.profiler on a live self-launched server (48 steps): aiter CK a8w8 GEMM 44.2% (12336 launches, 176us avg), Triton kernel_paged_attention_2d 33.8% (2165us avg x 16 steps... i.e. ~34.6ms of a ~102ms GPU-step), fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule_packed_decode (GDN state) 13.8% (14.1ms/step), everything else <10%. The paged-attention kernel reads only ~170MB of KV per step (64 seqs x 4 kv_heads x ~1300 ctx x 24 heads x 256 hd x 2 x bf16) => ~260x off the 1.28 TB/s roofline, because its grid is (num_seqs, num_kv_heads) = 256 programs with a fully serial context-length inner loop on a 104-CU device.

new_findings.accuracy_risk: low for TRITON_ATTN (upstream standard backend, same bf16 math); low for splitKV (module ships with 576/576 float32-golden validation, greedy text matched baseline in spot check; full-corpus greedy diff was cut off by the wall clock)
new_findings.expected_impact: +15 to +22% output tok/s vs the sealed baseline on this exact workload shape
new_findings.what: A/B on identical workloads (128 prompts x ISL1024 x OSL512 x conc64, one server per MI250X card, 2-3 repeats, all servers launched with the exact sealed base args): baseline replica 440.2/442.2/444.6 tok/s; --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN 536.6 (sequential) and 523.3 tok/s => +18 to +22%; VLLM_ROCM_SPLITKV_PA=1 + VLLM_ROCM_SPLITKV_PA_MAX_SEQS=1024 => 512.4/510.4 tok/s => +15.3/+15.4%. Greedy text spot-check identical between base and splitKV. The two levers hit the SAME bottleneck (see prior finding) via different kernels and are mutually exclusive (splitKV hooks only the ROCM_ATTN path).

new_findings.expected_impact: makes the +15% variant actually fire; prevents the -10% scratch-budget trap
new_findings.what: The split-KV takeover gate num_seqs*num_kv_heads <= DEFAULT_MAX_SEQS=64 silently rejects this workload (64 seqs x 4 kv_heads = 256 base programs), so VLLM_ROCM_SPLITKV_PA=1 alone is a NO-OP here; VLLM_ROCM_SPLITKV_PA_MAX_SEQS must be raised too. Both env vars are unregistered in vllm/envs.py (harmless 'Unknown vLLM environment variable' warning; the module reads os.environ directly). Also: raising VLLM_ROCM_SPLITKV_PA_MAX_SCRATCH_MIB so PART_MIN stays at 64/256 measured WORSE (463.0 tok/s) than the default 32MiB budget that forces PART_MIN up to 512 for a 6272-token bound - do not 'tune' the scratch budget upward on this workload.

new_findings.expected_impact: corrects the roofline denominator for future rounds
new_findings.what: rocm-smi's 'GPU Clock 800MHz' in the baseline summary is an idle-sample artifact: /sys/class/drm/cardN/device/pp_dpm_sclk shows the device boosts to the 1700MHz DPM level under real serving load and measured ceilings are 1264 GB/s copy BW and 125.7 TFLOPS bf16 GEMM (4096x16384x5120). sysfs is mounted ro in the container so clock locking is not available (and not needed).

new_findings.accuracy_risk: moderate (fp32->bf16 state storage on a W8A8 ckpt)
new_findings.expected_impact: unknown - candidate for next round, gated on accuracy (checkpoint declares mamba_ssm_dtype=float32)
new_findings.what: --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 works on this stack (overridden with a config warning), halves the GDN state page and drops the forced attention block size 784 -> 400 tokens (KV tokens 294,473 -> 328,145). Its throughput/accuracy effect was NOT measured (wall-clock cut); it interacts with both attention proposals (splitKV takeover re-validated at physical_block=400 in the server log).

new_findings.expected_impact: negative knowledge - closes an investigation branch
new_findings.what: aiter tuned-GEMM table is a dead end here, confirming platform law 1/5 by inspection: shipped a8w8_tuned_gemm.csv contains only gfx942/gfx950 rows (0 gfx90a), so the 5747 'not found tuned config' warnings across ~1150 shapes can never match; default heuristic is the shipped behavior.

proposal_set.name: triton_attn_decoder_backend
proposal_set.reason: Decoder attention was selected by elimination onto ROCM_ATTN, whose non-pow2-block fallback kernel_paged_attention_2d is 34% of the decode step and ~260x off KV-bandwidth roofline (grid=(64seqs,4kvheads)=256 programs, serial ctx loop). TRITON_ATTN swaps in upstream unified_attention (with its 3D split-KV decode path). Measured +18-22% output tok/s vs a same-conditions baseline replica (536.6 vs 440.2 seq.; 523.3 in parallel round) on the exact workload. head_dim=256 supported; no accuracy-risk flags expected (same bf16 math, different kernel). Caveat: first-run Triton JIT of kernel_unified_attention adds one transient latency spike (jit_monitor) - negligible over a 640s run.

proposal_set.name: splitkv_pa_takeover
proposal_set.reason: In-tree, float32-golden-validated (576/576) gfx90a split-KV paged-decode kernel already exists in this install (vllm/v1/attention/ops/rocm_splitkv_pa.py) and is wired into the ROCM_ATTN decode path, but its default gate (num_seqs*num_kv_heads<=64) rejects this workload (64x4=256), so both envs are co-required: SPLITKV_PA=1 alone is a silent no-op. With the gate opened: measured +15.3%/+15.4% over two matched rounds (512.4/510.4 vs 444.6/442.2), greedy text output identical to baseline in spot-check. Keep the DEFAULT scratch budget (32MiB) - it forces PART_MIN=512 which measured best; raising it regressed to 463. Mutually exclusive with proposal 1 (hooks only the ROCM_ATTN path) - use as fallback if TRITON_ATTN fails the Critic/accuracy gate.

residual_questions: Next round should A/B --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 (block 784->400 confirmed working) stacked on the winning attention variant, with a tightened gsm8k floor - it is the only remaining lever on the 14ms/step GDN state traffic, and the Coordinator's accuracy gate is authoritative for the fp32->bf16 state-storage question.

max-num-batched-tokens 4096 + prefill/decode overlap was not measured (server startup dominates the minute-scale budget): 29% of baseline wall clock buys ~0 output tokens (5 waves x ~38.5s near-zero-gen prefill). If further rounds are allotted, this is the largest remaining structural headroom (+42% ceiling per scout accounting).
TRITON_ATTN full greedy-output diff vs ROCM_ATTN was started but cut by the wall clock - recommend the Critic/accuracy-gate treat proposal 1's correctness as 'spot-checked, not exhaustively diffed'.
summary: Profiled the live decode step (torch.profiler, self-launched servers): 44% aiter a8w8 GEMM, 34% Triton kernel_paged_attention_2d (~260x off KV-bandwidth roofline because its grid is (seqs,kv_heads)=256 programs with a serial context loop), 14% GDN recurrent state. Delivered two ranked env/CLI variants that replace exactly that kernel: --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN (measured +18-22%) and the in-tree but gate-closed split-KV takeover (measured +15.3%, atomic 2-env set incl. the gate-raising var; default scratch budget is best). No source patch needed - both paths already exist. All numbers from matched A/B on leased cards, base args identical to sealed; mamba-bf16 and larger-batch-token levers left for next round (budget).
